decomposition_bga_critical.rotation_note: rigid rotation of the joint = -h x the mean tilt of its two faces; it moves the faces without straining the joint
decomposition_bga_critical.definition: membrane = in-plane displacement of each plate at its stiffness-weighted neutral plane (linear fit through the nodal column); bending = fitted slope x (joint face - neutral plane); residual = du - membrane - bending (through-thickness shear and non-linearity); free = free-expansion mismatch package - board, the laminate free strain sum(E t alpha dT)/sum(E t) of each column integrated along the ray from the package centre (no bending, no mutual restraint)
